cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

mechanism: A grades a pupil support as learned kindness and counters with ever greater sacrifices to remain its teacher rather than its beneficiary.
confusable: Not just accepting practical help: A escalates its own contribution whenever B reveals another favor.
comparison: Illness meals versus workplace cover and travel sacrifice.
seedUse: Use D43 lift/shifts/airport/holiday; S05 teacher-not-outdone interpretation supplies A reason for escalating beyond usefulness.
